title:
The {@link UiSdlEpic epic} used to remove the uploaded {@link File}s from the {@link UiSdlFieldSetFormFieldSetting form field} values.
After the {@link File}s have been removed from the given {@link UiSdlForm#id}, it proceeds to remove them
from the server.

The payload needs to receive:
- componentId: the {@link UiSdlFileUpload} to retrieve the selected {@link File}s
- formId: the {@link UiSdlForm#id} to remove the {@link File}s.
- fileNameField: the {@link UiSdlFieldSetFormFieldSetting form field} to reference the uploaded {@link File} names.
- fileUrlField: the {@link UiSdlFieldSetFormFieldSetting form field} to reference the uploaded {@link File} urls.
- fileNames: the {@link File} names that are being removed.
name: UiSdlEpicRemoveFilesFromState
